arguments.command:
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
from audit import audit
for path in sorted(Path('examples').glob('*.in.json')):
 t=time.monotonic(); p=subprocess.run(['python3','-B','submission/main.py'],input=path.read_bytes(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
 print(path.name,p.returncode,round(time.monotonic()-t,3),p.stderr.decode()[:3000])
 req=None
 try: req=json.loads(path.read_bytes())
 except ValueError: pass
 actual=json.loads(p.stdout); expected=json.loads(path.with_name(path.name.replace('.in.','.out.')).read_bytes())
 try: audit(req,actual,expected); print('OK', [c['objective'] for c in actual.get('cases',[])])
 except Exception as e: print(e, p.stdout.decode()[:1000]);raise
PY
g++ -O2 -std=c++17 submission/engine.cpp -o tmp/engine
for f in examples/*.in.native; do tmp/engine < "$f" > tmp/native.out; diff -u "${f/.in./.out.}" tmp/native.out; done
